description: Create the DIRECTORY(ies), if they do not already exist.

option.name: --context
tip: like -Z, or if CTX is specified then set the SELinux or SMACK security context to CTX

option.name: --mode
tip: set file mode (as in chmod), not a=rwx - umask

option.name: --parents
tip: no error if existing, make parent directories as needed, with their file modes unaffected by any -m option

option.name: --verbose
tip: print a message for each created directory

option.name: -Z
tip: set SELinux security context of each created directory to the default type
